en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the man accepts upon himself with a Penalty (Hadd), or fabrication, then denies it, would be whipped’.
I said, ‘What is your view that if he accepts with a Penalty (Hadd) upon himself, in which stoning is reached, would youasws have him stoned?’
He <sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No. But, I<sup>asws</sup> would have whipped him’.
